item.description:
Download `Pendenz-0.3.0.dmg` below, open it and drag Pendenz into Applications. It needs macOS 27. A copy you already have updates itself.
This version needs a server on 0.3.0. Until yours is updated, new changes wait on the Mac and go out once it is.
- Attach files of any kind to an item. Photos and files share one Attachments section, a click opens one in Quick Look, and Share and Remove are in its menu. Settings has the largest file the server takes. - Mark an item as doing from its menu or with a swipe to the right, and back to to do the same way. - A reminder's notification says when the item is due and in which project, and shows the start of its description. - Text in forms, menus and pickers is black or white again where it had turned gray. - A long description no longer holds up the app when its reminders are scheduled. - The app ignores the development argument `-apiURL`. Another program could use it to point the app at a different server, which emptied its local data.

Download `Pendenz-0.2.0.dmg` below, open it and drag Pendenz into Applications. It needs macOS 27. A copy you already have updates itself.
- A change that your server does not know yet is no longer lost. It waits on the Mac until the server is updated and then goes out in its old order. A line above the list says how many changes wait and which server version they need. - Settings has a Version section with the app's version and build and the version of your server.
